correctness.rationale: The Zak/Fourier lower bound is equivalent to a point-remainder Hardy inequality by explicit Hilbert-space duality. A shell Bernstein bound, discrete adjoint Hardy inequality and quantified spatial annuli prove beta=1. The disjoint Dirichlet-block family gives singular L2 growth at least N^3 while log-Sobolev norm squared is o(N^3) for every beta<1. Completeness, exactness and Gaussian zero use established sources. All boundary and quantifier cases handled analytically.
